name: VCFO Spectrum
note: Hex is the design value. oklch is the channel triplet for app/globals.css (oklch(var(--token) / <alpha-value>)). {ink} means the token aliases ink.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page canvas behind everything. Cool off-white; deep navy in dark. Never pure white, never pure black.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, dialogs, popovers, the top bar. Sits on surface with a line hairline and shadow-card.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: table header rows, input backgrounds on raised cards, empty-state grounds, skeleton blocks.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hovered table and list rows and the live step row. Lighter than the card in dark mode, so a hovered row lifts instead of sinking.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px hairline between rows and around cards. Decorative; never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows inside a card and between list items. Lighter than line, which frames cards and grid cells.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes and secondary buttons. Holds 3:1 on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: 2px structural rule under page heads and table heads, above totals rows. Same colour as ink in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and figures on every surface and every -soft ground. Navy, never black.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: meta, captions, helper text, table head text. 4.5:1 on every ground it is used on.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders, disabled labels, locked steps, the Other series. 3:1 only; never body text.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text that still reads as content: row meta, card body copy (Spectrum ink-2).

tokens.name: wash-ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text on the home card wash: the date and the step count. Lilac in dark mode so it reads on the violet wash.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The one action colour: primary buttons, links, active navigation, selection, progress, the current step. Text-safe in both themes.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of brand; link hover.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows, the current step ground, active nav ground, the brand wash behind a callout.

tokens.name: brand-text
tokens.usage: Text-safe blurple: links and the In progress chip word (Spectrum accent).

tokens.name: brand-line
tokens.usage: Edge of the In progress chip, the hatch stripes of the remaining Gantt part.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill. White in light; navy on the lighter dark-mode blue.

tokens.name: navy-fill
tokens.usage: The one main-button fill (one per card), the picked tab, the greeting band and e-Filing table heads. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: navy-fill-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of navy fills.

tokens.name: on-navy
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a navy fill.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Text-safe orange, the one highlight per screen region: what needs the user, the next payment, a new-item count, the version chip. Never a button, never page atmosphere.

tokens.name: highlight-bright
tokens.usage: Orange for marks with no small text: a 3px top edge, a dot beside a label. 3:1 on surface-raised.

tokens.name: highlight-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of small orange chips only. Never a large block; it turns muddy in dark mode.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Done, filed, paid, on track. Text-safe on surfaces and on positive-soft. Always with a word.

tokens.name: positive-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of positive chips and compare-table rows.

tokens.name: positive-mid
tokens.usage: Bar and dot fill for done or filed. Marks only, never text.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Due soon, waiting on someone, at risk. The prototype orange: a solid chip with on-status text, or text on a surface. Always with a word.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of warning chips and the changed rows of a compare table.

tokens.name: warning-mid
tokens.usage: Bar and dot fill for due soon or with the client. Marks only, never text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Overdue, failed, rejected, destructive actions. Always with a word.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of danger chips and removed rows.

tokens.name: danger-mid
tokens.usage: Bar and dot fill for overdue or failed. Marks only, never text.

tokens.name: danger-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of the danger button only. Overdue text uses danger.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Notes, internal-only bands, neutral callouts. Teal, so it never reads as the brand.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of info callouts and the lock-marked internal band.

tokens.name: info-line
tokens.usage: Edge of an info banner.

tokens.name: info-mid
tokens.usage: Blue dots and bars: the SBC owner dot and info marks. Marks only, never text.

tokens.name: upcoming
tokens.usage: The fifth state: not started, upcoming, queued. A solid chip with on-status text, or a grey mark. Not for prose.

tokens.name: upcoming-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of upcoming chips, empty heatmap cells, the track of a progress bar.

tokens.name: upcoming-mid
tokens.usage: Dot and bar fill for Not started.

tokens.name: identity
tokens.usage: MCA and identity: the MCA owner chip, ID and credential tiles, activity tiles.

tokens.name: identity-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of violet chips and tiles.

tokens.name: identity-mid
tokens.usage: Violet dots and bars: the MCA owner dot, the violet chip dot. Marks only, never text (prototype violet-mid).

tokens.name: on-status
tokens.usage: Text on a solid status fill (positive, warning, danger, brand, upcoming). White in light; navy on the lighter dark fills.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: The brand mark, as marks only: the 3px underline in the greeting card, the ring around the current step, the sidebar active rail, a card top tab. 3:1 on navy, not on white, so it never carries text.

tokens.name: gold-text
tokens.usage: The only gold that touches words: a version chip, a "you own this" label. 4.5:1 on surfaces.

tokens.name: owner-client
tokens.usage: Owner chip text: the client holds this step. Soft tint only, never a solid fill.

tokens.name: owner-client-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the client owner chip.

tokens.name: owner-sbc
tokens.usage: Owner chip text: SBC holds this step.

tokens.name: owner-sbc-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the SBC owner chip.

tokens.name: owner-mca
tokens.usage: Owner chip text: with the MCA or another authority.

tokens.name: owner-mca-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the MCA owner chip.

tokens.name: owner-manager
tokens.usage: Owner chip text: with a manager.

tokens.name: owner-manager-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the manager owner chip.

tokens.name: hero-gradient

value.light: radial-gradient(55% 140% at 0% 0%, rgba(99, 91, 255, 0.62), transparent 62%), radial-gradient(45% 130% at 42% 0%, rgba(14, 159, 142, 0.42), transparent 62%), radial-gradient(45% 140% at 100% 0%, rgba(242, 107, 29, 0.48), transparent 62%), radial-gradient(55% 110% at 78% 100%, rgba(232, 69, 122, 0.4), transparent 62%), radial-gradient(45% 100% at 20% 100%, rgba(47, 111, 235, 0.34), transparent 62%), #e9e7ff
value.dark: radial-gradient(55% 140% at 0% 0%, rgba(122, 114, 255, 0.55), transparent 62%), radial-gradient(45% 130% at 42% 0%, rgba(14, 159, 142, 0.34), transparent 62%), radial-gradient(45% 140% at 100% 0%, rgba(242, 107, 29, 0.32), transparent 62%), radial-gradient(55% 110% at 78% 100%, rgba(232, 69, 122, 0.3), transparent 62%), #15132e

tokens.usage: The home card colour wash (R-17). The only gradient in the product.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid outline, offset 2px, on every interactive element. Holds 3:1 on every surface including the navy sidebar.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind dialogs and bottom sheets. The only translucent colour; nothing uses blur.

tokens.name: side
tokens.usage: Desktop sidebar ground. Navy gives the app its weight; in dark mode it matches the surface and side-line separates it.

tokens.name: side-deep
tokens.usage: The front mountain on the sign-in page, one step off the navy ground (prototype navy-2).

tokens.name: side-ink
tokens.usage: Sidebar labels and icons.

tokens.name: side-muted
tokens.usage: Sidebar group titles and meta. 4.5:1 on side.

tokens.name: side-active
tokens.usage: Ground of the active sidebar item; its icon is side-ink.

tokens.name: side-line
tokens.usage: Hairline between sidebar groups and along the sidebar edge.

tokens.name: side-active-ink
tokens.usage: Label of the active sidebar row (lilac).

tokens.name: side-hover
tokens.usage: Ground of a hovered sidebar row.

tokens.name: data-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 (blue). Categorical slots are assigned in fixed order, never cycled, and never used for UI chips.

tokens.name: data-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2 (orange).

tokens.name: data-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3 (aqua). Below 3:1 on the light surface: needs direct labels or a table view.

tokens.name: data-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4 (yellow). Below 3:1 on the light surface: needs direct labels or a table view.

tokens.name: data-5
tokens.usage: Chart series 5 (violet).

tokens.name: data-6
tokens.usage: Chart series 6 (green). Past six series, fold to Other (ink-faint) or facet.

tokens.name: waiting
tokens.usage: Waiting: the step sits with someone outside SBC. Teal, text-safe.

tokens.name: waiting-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of Waiting chips.

tokens.name: waiting-mid
tokens.usage: Dot and bar fill for Waiting.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Text of a warning banner.

tokens.name: caution-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a warning banner.

tokens.name: caution-line
tokens.usage: Edge of a warning banner.

fonts.name: Roboto
fonts.note: One face for the interface. 500 does the work of bold; 700 is for display sizes and the logo (R-28).

fonts.name: Roboto Mono
fonts.note: Identifiers only: CIN, PAN, GSTIN, DIN, SRN, ARN, step and form codes.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per screen at most: the greeting on Today, the company name on a client home.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page titles. Sits above a 2px rule.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Group headers inside cards; table group rows.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Eleven of fourteen filings are done.
styles.usage: Default UI text and table cells on desktop.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Client portal reading text and phone screens.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Meta, captions, timestamps, helper text; usually ink-muted.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section heads, table heads, stat labels. Uppercase is applied by the style; write sentence case.

styles.name: chip
styles.usage: Status and count chips. Sentence case, never uppercase.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Amounts and counts inside tables; tabular numerals, right-aligned.

styles.name: figure-lg
styles.usage: Totals rows and the figure on a KPI card.

styles.name: figure-xl
styles.usage: The one headline number in a hero stat row.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Identifiers and codes. Never for prose or amounts.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, chip vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips, inside inputs, icon tile padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding, gaps between panels in a grid.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop, the mobile gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on phone screens, dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections, desktop page margins.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page regions, below the page head.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top of marketing and auth pages.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, inputs, small buttons. One radius: 6px on every box (R-44).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, nav rows, icon tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, popovers, menus.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The home card and bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-mark
tokens.usage: Marks of 12 to 23px: checkboxes, step squares, swatches, small count badges. Tailwind rounded-sm and rounded-mark both read it.

tokens.name: radius-bar
tokens.usage: Bars under 12px: progress, Gantt, phase track.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Switch knobs and people avatars only. Nothing else is a pill.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons and inputs: inside table rows, card heads and dense toolbars; icon buttons in rows.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button and input height on desktop. One main (navy) button per card.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary actions on forms, dialogs, and every button on phone screens.

tokens.name: control-min-width
tokens.usage: Minimum width of any button with a text label. Labels are two words at most and never wrap.

tokens.name: chip-height
tokens.usage: Every status, owner and count chip. Text is the chip style, padding 0 8px, radius-sm.

tokens.name: chip-min-width
tokens.usage: Status chips inside a table column are 108px wide, so the column reads as one block and labels sit centred. Chips in running text hug their content.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: Table rows (R-07, Stripe T1). Chips sit vertically centred with 10px above and below.

tokens.name: tile
tokens.usage: Icon tiles in section heads and list rows, radius-md.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside chips and 12px meta.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Icons in buttons, table cells and inputs.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Sidebar navigation and phone screens.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards have no shadow (R-02); the 1.5px line is the edge.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Menus, tooltips, toasts, popovers.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the command bar.

tokens.name: shadow-tile
tokens.usage: Number tiles floating on the home card wash.

tokens.name: shine
tokens.usage: The faint top shine of the main button.

tokens.name: shadow-control
tokens.usage: The faint drop under secondary buttons, inputs and the switch thumb. Light mode only.

tokens.name: wash-tile
tokens.usage: Ground of a number tile on the wash.

tokens.name: wash-tile-line
tokens.usage: Edge of a number tile on the wash.

tokens.name: hero-image-veil
tokens.usage: Veil over a photo skin on the greeting card (Profile > Appearance), so its dark text stays readable.

tokens.name: shadow-signin
tokens.usage: The deep shadow under the sign-in card on the navy ground.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Rows, card frames, inputs.

tokens.name: rule-width
tokens.usage: Structural rules: page head, table head, totals, focus outline.

tokens.name: stat-rule
tokens.usage: The coloured top edge of a KPI card or the next-payment card, in its tone.
